niche: a rural electric cooperative's 2027 full groundline inspection, sized by how many of its wood poles will be 50 or older, when about one pole in nine in service carries no year of setting
analyst_test: a strong analyst who parses every brand and reads every account spreads the poles with no year of setting like the pre-1987 poles whose brand was read, or in proportion to each year's additions, and files a count of poles 50 or older thousands off (about 26,000 or 35,300 against 33,000)
domain_test: the number of poles in service at or above each age when the install year is missing for one pole in seven and missing more often the older the pole: the surviving poles of each pre-conversion vintage are rebuilt as that vintage's additions times a survivor curve fitted to the unaged retirements of the pre-conversion poles (the simulated plant-record method), and the poles with no year are spread over what that leaves after the poles whose brand was read
layer2_pattern: own:unrecorded install years rebuilt from vintage additions through a survivor curve fitted to the unaged retirements
layer1: a pole register built from the mapping system: poles set since the 1987 conversion carry the work order's year and number, older poles carry the brand only where the 2016 to 2025 inspectors could read it, typed as it read (two or four digits, month and year, supplier or treatment codes, a few with a digit unread), blank for the rest

plant accounts in units: the ledger's poles added, retired and in service each year 1938 to 1986 typed up at the conversion, the pre-1987 poles carried as one group with a retirement count a year since, and the property records of poles set since 1987 by year set
retirements booked when the work order closes, sometimes in the following year, so the accounts and the register differ by the open orders
streetlight-only poles (account 373) in the register beside the distribution poles
two districts merged in 2019, with their feeders renumbered and poles not edited since still carrying the old district code
a work order extract at the grain of the order, raised against one location, with orders raised twice and cancelled and replacement orders still open
stakeholder_role: manager of system maintenance, rural electric cooperative

spine.entity: one pole in service at the end of 2026

world.geography: United States (the cooperative, its service area and people are fictional)

driver: The decisive quantity is how many units in service are at least a given age when many units' start dates were never recorded and are missing more often the older the unit; the units still in service from each start year are that year's intake times the chance of lasting to its present age, a curve fitted to the yearly outflow of the unrecorded group, so the unrecorded units are spread over start years by what that leaves once the recorded ones are taken out, not like the recorded ones and not in proportion to intake.
driver_concrete: How many of Kestrin Valley Electric Cooperative's distribution poles on the 30 September 2026 register were set in 1977 or earlier, with the poles that have no year of setting spread over the pre-1987 years as each year's additions times a survivor curve fitted to the ledger's year-end balances from 1938 to 2025, less the poles of that year whose brand was read; not spread like the poles whose year is known, not in proportion to additions, and not on a curve whose shape cannot follow the ledger.
stump: A competent analyst who parses every brand and reads every account spreads the poles with no year of setting like the poles whose year is known, or in proportion to each year's additions, and files a count of poles 50 or older thousands off; brands fade with age, so the poles with no year are the oldest, and each year's survivors are its additions thinned by decades of retirements that climb after forty years, so only a survivor curve fitted to the ledger's balances, applied to each year's additions, says how many poles of each age are still standing.
mechanism_source: own: the seed's quantity (a count on a distribution read against a fixed limit) kept; DA24's affordability world held no unspent analytical step (design note, Tried and rejected), so the world was redrawn to a cooperative's pole plant
notes: Drawn 2026-10-23 from seed DA24's quantity only (a count on a distribution read against a fixed limit); the seed's affordability world held no unspent analytical step and was redrawn (design note, Draw and Tried and rejected). WARNs answered in the design note's Draw.
